model_identity: Shared checkpoint is Qwen3.5-9B; inspected model directories also contain Qwen3-8B. No Qwen3.5-8B directory found in bounded search.
comparison_required: DeltaTrace versus this official FT hybrid variant on the SAME actual Qwen3.5 checkpoint, dtype, backend, input trajectory, target span and eligible tokens. No cross-model quality or cost victory.

review_findings.finding: linearize_norm returns raw weight/rms for Qwen3_5RMSNorm, while the loaded native model uses(1+weight)/rms. Full-attention value path calls this helper.
review_findings.status: Source-level concrete semantic mismatch against the pinned native model; magnitude/quality effect not yet measured.

review_findings.finding: Full-attention LayerAttnInput has no output sigmoid gate; GDN LayerAttnInput projects pre-output-norm core value mixtures and discards core_ref, with no gated output RMS/SiLU contribution in that triple.
review_findings.status: Layer decomposition boundary omission visible in source. No claim about resulting metric degradation without a matched test.

review_findings.finding: Explicit B1 guard, GDN replay without attention_mask, identity probe expands value dimension to S and materializes per-head S-square mixing; full layers require eager/output_attentions.
review_findings.status: Current interface does not meet this project default-FA/variable-batch/linear-memory requirements.

review_findings.finding: Capture wrapper delegates to the original kernel and the identity probe calls that same kernel. The V-linear recurrence identity is legitimate exact-real algebra conditional on q/k/g/beta; it is an auxiliary probe, not automatically a shadow implementation.
review_findings.status: Do not falsely classify genuine native auxiliary work as shadow work. Charge its cost and verify actual default FLA execution/precision before use.

review_findings.finding: Tiny7-token test reconstructs pre-norm recurrence core. It does not check native full mixer/decoder boundaries, default FA/FLA workload, real batched padding or official needle/RISE/MAS.
review_findings.status: Useful narrow core test; insufficient evidence for full-model quality.

review_findings.finding: Smoke script uses handcrafted samples and double argsort ranks without tie averaging, then compares across Qwen3.5-9B/Qwen3-8B. This is not the author original benchmark requested here.
review_findings.status: Do not run as replacement quality benchmark or accept the PASS string as evidence.
